title: Customers who have placed orders
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on customers, orders.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY name

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INT, name VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE orders (id INT, customer_id INT, amount INT); INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'A'), (2, 'B'), (3, 'C'), (4, 'D'); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 1, 100), (2, 1, 200), (3, 3, 150);
